product_metadata.title: Paddywax Hygge Artisan Hand-Poured Scented Candle, 15-Ounce, Teakwood + Jasmine
features: SCENTED SOY CANDLE: Fill your home with a fresh scent with our natural soy candle. Every high-quality large candle in our Hygge Collection tells a special fragrance story to fit your mood and energy.

EARTH-FRIENDLY: This scented candle comes in a pretty reusable ceramic jar with a lid to help you add to your home’s aesthetic while remaining earth conscious. Reuse the container to store small items or for decoration.
LONG-LASTING CANDLE: Our jar candle is carefully hand poured at our Nashville factory and filled with a unique scent. This fragrant candle also features a clean-burning cotton wick.
UPCYCLED BEAUTY: Our scented soy candle is designed with upcycling in mind—after you burn your candle, freeze the jar overnight to remove the wax and wick and create a charming storage container.
ARTFULLY CRAFTED: Paddywax is an artisan company specializing in candles and diffusers made with quality materials, inspiring color palettes, and alluring scents to set your home’s tone.
description: Hygge (Pronounced 'hooga') is the Danish word for coziness. Whether it's curling up with a good book or having a long dinner with friends, you know the feeling. Introduce Hygge into your daily life with this Scandi-inspired collection. Hand poured into a light blue 15-ounce matte ceramic vessel with a copper lid, this candle really brings home the warm minimalism trend. Artfully Crafted - Paddywax is an artisan candle company in Nashville, TN, founded in 1996. Each Paddywax candle features a soy wax blend hand-poured into an easily repurposed vessel with U.S.-sourced cotton wicks. Specializing in candles and diffusers that compliment home decor trends, Paddywax candles are made with quality materials, inspiring color palettes, and intriguing fragrances to set the tone in your home.
